better.en: On Mac, new automatic AI tasks also wait when memory is tight, and Stop cancels them before they start.
better.pt-BR: No Mac, novas tarefas automáticas das IAs também aguardam quando falta memória, e Parar cancela as que ainda não começaram.
better.es: En Mac, las nuevas tareas automáticas de IA también esperan si falta memoria y Detener cancela las que aún no han empezado.
better.fr: Sur Mac, les nouvelles tâches automatiques des IA attendent aussi si la mémoire manque, et Arrêter annule celles qui n’ont pas démarré.
better.de: Auch auf dem Mac warten neue automatische KI-Aufgaben bei knappem Arbeitsspeicher; Stoppen bricht sie vor dem Start ab.

decisions: | R-next | 2026-10-24 | macOS extends the existing automatic-worker memory admission with libproc resident bytes and exact owned-process identity checks before and after each memory query. Resident pages shared between processes may count for each, conservatively delaying new work. Existing thresholds, cancellation, count and quota guards remain; Linux memory admission and real parallel cost measurement remain unfinished. | AI |
